summary: Full backend + frontend sweep in response to user report 'website is not working'. Nothing is broken. All 19 pytest tests pass (14 sim + 5 integrations: /integrations/status, /files list, upload+download+delete, /copilot/ask). All 11 routes return 200 with 0 console errors and 0 5xx API responses. Overview reset/toggle, Missions new-task submit, Simulation all 5 network buttons + inject failure, Experiments run/compare, Architecture all 6 layer expanders, Event Log filters (11 present), Judge start, Files upload (verified appears in gallery), Settings integration status (Emergent + Perplexity + online + low), Copilot open+send+answer, mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow + mobile-nav-toggle present — all pass.
action_items: Docs-only mismatch (no code fix needed unless you want alignment): Review request lists testids that differ from the actual implementation — Files category tabs are `files-cat-{delivery|incident|recon}` (not `files-tab-*`); Copilot send button is `copilot-send-button` (not `copilot-send`); Swarm agent inspector is opened by clicking a table row `swarm-agent-row-{id}` — there is no `agent-marker` testid on the SVG map itself. All flows still work; only the review checklist naming is off.
critical_code_review_comments: Global in-memory `world` and shared `copilot_col`/`files_col` are fine for demo; not multi-tenant safe.
/api/copilot/ask has no rate limiting — a malicious client could exhaust the Perplexity quota.
Upload endpoint validates size and category but not mime magic bytes — relies on client-supplied content_type only. Low-risk for demo.
seed_data_creation: test_files_upload_and_persist creates + soft-deletes a 1x1 PNG under ref_id TEST-DEL-001. Frontend upload test left one tiny.png in the recon category gallery.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integrations regression: /app/backend/tests/test_integrations.py. Actual UI testids: Files tabs = files-cat-{id}, Copilot send = copilot-send-button, Swarm inspector opens via swarm-agent-row-{id}. Copilot backend returns fast for simple questions (~2s) but review says up to 60s allowed. Mobile toggle = mobile-nav-toggle.
rca of the issue: User's 'website is not working' report was almost certainly a transient pod-restart / cold-boot moment as main agent suspected. Post-recovery verification: every endpoint returns healthy data, every page renders, both integrations report online, and Playwright observed 0 console errors and 0 failed API requests across a full nav sweep + interactive flows.
